final: WITH ts AS (SELECT team_id, SUM(g - w) AS team_sum FROM manager WHERE team_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY team_id), tot AS (SELECT SUM(team_sum) AS overall_total FROM ts WHERE team_sum IS NOT NULL), avgt AS (SELECT AVG(team_sum) AS avg_team_sum FROM ts WHERE team_sum IS NOT NULL), shares AS (SELECT ts.team_id, ts.team_sum, ts.team_sum * 1.0 / tot.overall_total AS share, avgt.avg_team_sum FROM ts JOIN tot ON tot.overall_total IS NOT NULL JOIN avgt ON avgt.avg_team_sum IS NOT NULL WHERE ts.team_sum IS NOT NULL), kept AS (SELECT * FROM shares WHERE team_sum > avg_team_sum) SELECT AVG(team_sum) AS avg_kept_team_sum, AVG(share) AS avg_kept_share, AVG(team_sum - avg_team_sum) AS avg_kept_minus_avg FROM kept
